onboarding.title: Onboarding
onboarding.subtitle: New hires working through their onboarding checklist
onboarding.startIntro: Creates the new hire's onboarding checklist, assigns tasks to them, their manager and HR, and notifies everyone.
onboarding.emptyBody: Start onboarding when someone joins to give them a checklist to work through.
onboarding.notePlaceholder: Optional — what was done, links, follow-ups
onboarding.readinessHint: Checked against the employee's records, separately from the checklist.
onboarding.overdueBody: Escalate to notify the task owners' managers.
onboarding.escalated: Managers reminded about {{ count }} overdue task(s)
onboarding.completedBody: Every task on {{ name }}'s checklist is done.
onboarding.cancelledBody: This checklist is closed; its tasks can no longer be completed.
onboarding.cancelBody: The checklist closes and the employee is notified. This can't be undone.
onboarding.trackLabel: {{ done }} of {{ total }} tasks done, {{ overdue }} overdue
onboarding.noTasksForOwner: Nothing on this checklist for them.
onboarding.targetHint: {{ count }} days. Task due dates are spread between the start date and this day.
onboarding.targetBeforeStart: Pick a date on or after the start date
onboarding.historyEmptyBody: Completed and cancelled onboardings show up here.
onboarding.noTrainings: No trainings in the catalog yet.
onboarding.trainingsHint: The new hire is enrolled in these, and a task to complete them is added to the checklist.
onboarding.notOnRecordBody: You can still mark this done, for example if it's handled outside Humano.
onboarding.notStarted: No onboarding for this person yet.

onboardingChecklist.title: Onboarding checklist
onboardingChecklist.lead: Every new onboarding starts from these tasks. Changes apply to onboardings started after you save.
onboardingChecklist.builtInBody: Edit it to fit how your company onboards people, then save to make it yours.
onboardingChecklist.lengthHint: New onboardings finish this many days after the start unless another date is picked. Due days below are counted on an onboarding this long; shorter or longer ones scale them.
onboardingChecklist.lengthInvalid: Use a length between 1 and 365 days.
onboardingChecklist.previewLabel: Where the tasks fall across a default-length onboarding
onboardingChecklist.dueDayInvalid: Pick a day from 0 to {{ days }}.
onboardingChecklist.appliesHint: Onboardings already in progress keep their own tasks.
